result.evidence:
To answer "what should I tell my other guy": F6 works when tested alone. It breaks once it's merged with the drill engine your other agent built (F5, already merged into master). Everything he needs to change is in the fix field of defect 1.

Setup: `git switch --detach v2/f6` (HEAD 372267a, 16 F6 commits). I committed nothing, the worktree is clean, and nothing is left running on port 8016.

1. Checks, run by me:
   - `PYTHONPATH=. python3 server/checks/f6.py`: all 14 "ok F6 ..." lines, exit 0.
   - `f6.py --browser` (headless shell on 8016, throwaway DB): "ok F6 pages: no marking in a live report, the /s/ landing, forwards, stopped links, the admin".
   - `PYTHONPATH=. python3 server/test_flow.py`: "all good".
   - The v2/f6 branch starts from 1e09252, before the F5 merge. `git merge-tree` with master is clean. I unpacked the merged tree into the scratchpad; test_flow there also prints "all good".
2. §2.12 acceptance:
   - Shell 14–17 pass (my own probes): integer report ids, and a Bug report stores kind 'page'. 11 files gives 400, an 11 MB PNG 413, a GIF 200. key_wrong in an unfinished mock gives 409, and the live box has no 'marked'. The 11th report in an hour gives 429. A dispute sets disputed=1, and the 6th open dispute gives 409. Admin with the token unset gives 404, a wrong token 403, the right one 200, and a path-traversal file name 404. /api/reports/fixed carries no learner code.
   - Sets, called directly through sets.serve: two learners get the sharer's exact pairs, and the stems match. The public summary has no stem, seed or "stem" key. Results give 403 to others. Revoked gives 410, an unknown code 404, and today's challenge item 409.
   - Through the real endpoint on the merged tree it fails. A second learner who starts with POST /api/drill {pool:'set'} gets identical stems, but after finishing, GET /api/sets/{code} shows taken 0 (the spec says 1) and results list 0 takers. So QBank acceptance 15 fails. Revoke then POST {pool:'set'} does give 410.
3. My own headless run: ?feedback opens "Send feedback" with Bug, Idea, Confusing and Other. The device-details box and the reply helper are there. Esc closes the modal, and the draft is still there after reopening. Send shows "Report #n is in". At 390px the modal is full-screen, and /s/ and /admin/reports don't scroll sideways. No page errors.
4. Sample of 18 requirements, spread across the list:
   - R17 integer ids: pass.
   - R17 10 an hour: pass (20 a day is in the code).
   - R17 file limits: pass.
   - Shell 2.10 in-browser downscale to 2000px, WebP with JPEG fallback, GIF sent as-is: pass (read in report.js).
   - Shell 2.10 drafts in sessionStorage, the 429 text, the network-error text and Retry: pass.
   - Shell 2.10 "Reported" button and the 5-dispute cap text: pass.
   - Shell §10 hmac admin check, 404 when unset, key_right reopens the trap: pass.
   - U3 40 MB GIF and 20 MB webm stored at full size, 60 MB GIF gives 413 naming 50 MB, zip 415: pass (in the check).
   - U3 instant-check outcomes, me too, fixed list: pass.
   - X10 "Remind me after the test" first, "The clock keeps running": pass.
   - V6 admin Labels view (15% of 20 or more learners): pass.
   - R18(c) 8-character Crockford code, the same set gives the same link, 30 an hour: pass.
   - R18(c) navigator.share only from a tap on "More ways to share": pass.
   - P22/U28 twins, same template with different seeds per taker: passes through sets.serve, fails through /api/drill.
   - V17 help context is hidden until the visitor answers: passes at the API, but the landing's Try it is broken.
   - W20 word-list landing lists the words: pass.
   - SR19 re-scoring: pass.
   - QBank 15: fails when merged.
5. `git diff --stat master...HEAD` shows only the 8 files F6 owns (5237+/15−). db.py is untouched. No classes, teacher or homework features in F6's files. Colours come from tokens, and the only accent is var(--amber). Report files are git-ignored.

defects.where: server/drill.py _pool, pool == 'set' (F5 -> S4's file, on master), against F6's hooks sets.serve and sets.link
defects.what:
The drill reads sets.items directly and never calls sets.serve or sets.link. Tested on the merged tree:
- Takers who start with POST /api/drill {pool:'set'} get no shared_from, so GET /api/sets/{code} shows taken 0 and the owner's results list no takers. QBank acceptance 15 (as amended) and §2.12 F6's 'read through sets' fail.
- A twin (U28 slot-only) set returns 422 'expected [template, seed] pairs'.
- A fresh or twin share of a session serves the sharer's exact seeds, so answers can be passed around. This defeats P22/X22 and decision 1's reasoning.
- A words set returns 500 (KeyError 'template').
- cfg.granted skips the owner access re-check and the quarantine skip that serve() does.
defects.fix:
For the other agent, who owns drill.py:
- In pool == 'set', call sets.serve(code, learner, True if body.get('exact') is False else None) and use its 'items' pairs. Keep granted, since serve() already re-checked access and skipped removed items. Let its 404/410/409 through, and return 422 for kind 'words'.
- Add 'show_name' to FIELDS.
- Once the session row exists, call sets.link(new_sid, code, bool(body.get('show_name'))).
- Do the same in Tests' shared start (S5, POST /api/mock/new {kind:'shared'}).

F6-side stopgap in its own files: POST /api/sets/{code}/start (serve() + the legacy drill.create(..., items=) + link()), or _takers also matching json_extract(cfg,'$.pool')='set' AND json_extract(cfg,'$.ids')=code.

defects.where: web/s/index.html visitor() go(): the body of POST /api/drill
defects.what: The landing's Start this set, Try it and Fresh versions instead send {pool:'set', ids, source:'shared', show_name, count?}. On master, F5's drill refuses this with 422 {field:'show_name', reason:'unknown field'}. On the v2/f6 branch alone it returns 400 'pick at least one topic'. So no Review share or V17 help link can be started from /s/, and V17 acceptance 1 ('after a second learner answers through the landing') cannot pass.
defects.fix: Don't send show_name to /api/drill. Either send it to an F6 start endpoint that calls sets.link, or wait for drill.py to accept it (defect 1). Add a --browser step that clicks Try it on a help link and waits for the question, then for the sharer's context.

defects.what: The share checks stand in for the engine with sets.serve + drill.create + sets.link instead of calling POST /api/drill {pool:'set'}. The browser check stops before clicking Try it. That is why both integration failures above passed all checks.
defects.fix: Once the drill hook lands, make sets_exact start the second learner with POST /api/drill {pool:'set', ids: code} and assert GET /api/sets/{code} taken == 1. In --browser, click Try it.

defects.what: A help share's context is released only once the visitor has an attempt on the exact (template, seed). A help share with cfg.fresh serves a twin seed, so the visitor never sees 'Your friend picked C...'.
defects.fix: When cfg.fresh is set, release item n's context once the visitor has answered slot n in their linked session (match by position, as _marks does), not by the exact address.
